name: After § 11
title: REPORT on the 2023 and 2024 Commission reports on Serbia
part_text: 11a. Urges the European People’s Party (EPP) to freeze the associate member status of the Serbian Progressive Party (SNS) in view of the ruling party’s role in the rollback of Serbian democracy, its close ties with Russia, and President Vucic’s vow to join Vladimir Putin and many other dictators at the 9 May 2025 event celebrating the army that is killing Ukrainians and threatening EU Member States;
